label: Creality SPARKX - Telegram Alert (example)
info:
Example flow: sends a Telegram message when the Creality SPARKX 'Problem' binary_sensor turns on, using the error code / description attributes decoded by the ha-creality-sparkx integration.

Before importing, edit:
1. The 'Trigger' node's entity_id -> your printer's binary_sensor.<name>_problem entity.
2. The 'telegram bot' config node -> your own bot token (from @BotFather).
3. The chatId set inside the 'Format alert' function node -> your own Telegram chat id.

The 'Raw event (debug)' node is wired in on purpose so you can inspect the real payload shape the first time an actual printer error fires, in case your node-red-contrib-home-assistant-websocket version nests the attributes differently than msg.data.event.new_state.attributes.

name: Format alert
